high_level_description: The image depicts a man standing on a wooden pier by the water. The setting appears to be a tropical or coastal location, possibly a resort, given the overwater bungalows visible in the background. The shirt has a geometric pattern and a small zipper at the front. He also wears a silver watch on his left wrist and a ring on his right hand.
